title: Ethics
learning_outcomes: Explain consequences duties virtues in the context of ethics.
Compare and distinguish facts and values in the context of ethics.
Apply rights and interests in the context of ethics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical revision in the context of ethics.

lessons.title: Consequences duties virtues
lessons.outcome: Explain consequences duties virtues in the context of ethics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving consequences duties virtues; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to ethical decision memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain consequences duties virtues from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of consequences duties virtues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Facts and values
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish facts and values in the context of ethics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving facts and values; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to ethical decision memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain facts and values from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of facts and values; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Rights and interests
lessons.outcome: Apply rights and interests in the context of ethics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rights and interests; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to ethical decision memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rights and interests from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rights and interests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Ethical revision
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical revision in the context of ethics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ethical revision; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to ethical decision memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ethical revision from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ethical revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of consequences duties virtues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of facts and values; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of rights and interests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of ethical revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
